desc: Derive/verify the correctness argument: shortest answer = S + reverse(S[:n-L]) where L is the longest palindromic suffix length (verified on ABC, Z, TREE).

Implement the full program: KMP prefix function of pattern reverse(S), stream S through the automaton to get L, output S + S[:n-L][::-1] via sys.stdout.buffer.write (handles n=1 and fully-palindromic S automatically).
Cross-check logic on small cases / edge cases (n=1, already-palindrome, ABC, TREE) — traced and consistent.
Complexity/memory review: O(n) time (amortized ~2·10^6 steps), single n-length pi list, no 2n+1 concatenation needed.
